response.sql: WITH race_stats AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), average_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total FROM race_stats), above_average AS (SELECT rs.total_points, rs.avg_laps, rs.total_points - at.avg_total as exceeds FROM race_stats rs CROSS JOIN average_total at WHERE rs.total_points > at.avg_total) SELECT SUM(total_points) as combined_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) as average_laps_completed, AVG(exceeds) as average_exceeds FROM above_average
